name: com.splatterfacegames.phone-mass-controllers
description: Turn a Unity game into the host for a room full of phone controllers. Players scan a QR code, their phone's browser loads a controller page served by the game itself — no app, no Node, no relay server. Pure C#. Inspired by HappyFunTimes. Port of godot-phone-mass-controllers.

samples.description: Lobby + buzzer demo: QR join, per-phone secret symbol, buzz-on-your-symbol scoring.
